extra_vocab.en: a period when business or the economy gets worse
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，the recent downturn in the retail industry 指零售業近期景氣下滑；用 Despite 開頭，表示即使環境不好，公司仍決定照常進行年度薪資審核。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: downturn 是可數名詞，常用 a downturn in + 領域（a downturn in sales）；反義詞是 upturn。

example.en: Many small firms closed during the economic downturn last year.
example.zh: 去年的經濟衰退期間，許多小公司倒閉。

example.en: A downturn in sales forced the store to reduce its staff.
example.zh: 銷售下滑迫使這家店縮減人力。

example.en: The report predicts a sharp downturn in housing prices.
example.zh: 報告預測房價將急遽下滑。

example.en: Companies must control costs carefully during a downturn.
example.zh: 景氣衰退期間，公司必須謹慎控制成本。

examples.en: The downturn has affected every department in the company.
examples.zh: 這次衰退影響了公司的每一個部門。

examples.en: Analysts expect the downturn to last until the end of the year.
examples.zh: 分析師預期這波衰退會持續到年底。

confusable.diff: downtown 是「市中心」，拼法只差一個字母，與景氣無關。

example.en: Our head office is located in the downtown area of the city.
example.zh: 我們的總公司位在城市的市中心區。

similar.diff: decline 是較中性的「下降」，可用於任何數字；downturn 特指景氣或業績轉為下滑。

example.en: We saw a steady decline in orders over the summer.
example.zh: 夏天期間，我們的訂單穩定下降。

similar.diff: slump 是「突然、大幅的低迷」，語氣更強、更口語；downturn 較正式。

example.en: The company is trying to recover from a long sales slump.
example.zh: 公司正努力從長期的銷售低迷中恢復。

example.en: The recession lasted for almost two years in this country.
example.zh: 這個國家的經濟衰退持續了將近兩年。

example.en: Demand for our products dropped during the winter months.
example.zh: 冬季期間，我們產品的需求下降了。

example.en: Economists expect a slow recovery in the retail sector.
example.zh: 經濟學家預期零售業會緩慢復甦。

extra_vocab.en: a small change made to make something better or more correct
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，salary adjustments 指依績效評等做的「薪資調整」，通常是加薪；這是人資通知中很常見的委婉說法。

example.en: We need to make an adjustment to the delivery schedule.
example.zh: 我們需要對送貨時程做出調整。

example.en: Every salary adjustment must be approved by the director.
example.zh: 每一項薪資調整都必須經主任核准。

example.en: The supplier announced a price adjustment starting next month.
example.zh: 供應商宣布下個月起調整價格。

example.en: Only minor adjustments were needed before the final version.
example.zh: 最終版本之前，只需要小幅調整。

examples.en: Please send me the adjustments you would like to make.
examples.zh: 請把你想做的調整寄給我。

examples.en: A few adjustments to the plan could reduce our costs.
examples.zh: 對計畫稍作調整，可能降低我們的成本。

confusable.diff: adjourn 是「休會、暫停（會議）」，拼法開頭相似，但意思不同。

example.en: The chairman decided to adjourn the meeting until Monday.
example.zh: 主席決定將會議延到週一再開。

confusable.diff: adjacent 是「相鄰的」，開頭拼法相似，與調整無關。

example.en: The conference room is adjacent to the main office.
example.zh: 會議室就在主辦公室隔壁。

similar.diff: change 是一般的「改變」，可大可小；adjustment 通常指為了更好而做的小幅修正。

example.en: The change in policy surprised many of the employees.
example.zh: 政策的改變讓許多員工感到驚訝。

similar.diff: modification 是較正式的「修改」，常用於設計或規格；adjustment 較常用於數字或安排。

example.en: The engineers proposed a modification to the original design.
example.zh: 工程師提議修改原始設計。

example.en: The revision of the contract took almost two weeks.
example.zh: 修訂合約花了將近兩週。

example.en: Please make the corrections before sending the report.
example.zh: 寄出報告前請先做更正。

example.en: We will send you an update on the schedule tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們明天會寄給您行程的最新資訊。

derived.link: adjust 是詞幹；adjust + -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement

extra_vocab.en: in a way that fits the situation or what was just said
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，will be applied accordingly 表示薪資調整會「依照績效評等」相應套用，accordingly 把前面的評等與後面的結果連起來，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: accordingly 是副詞，不能像 and、but 一樣連接兩個完整子句；要連接時用分號或句號隔開。

example.en: Please read the notice carefully and act accordingly.
example.zh: 請仔細閱讀通知並據此行動。

example.en: The road will be closed, so please plan accordingly.
example.zh: 這條路會封閉，請據此做好安排。

example.en: If demand rises, we will adjust production accordingly.
example.zh: 如果需求上升，我們會相應調整產量。

examples.en: The schedule has changed, and staff will be informed accordingly.
examples.zh: 時程已經改變，員工將會被相應通知。

examples.en: Prices will be set accordingly once the costs are confirmed.
examples.zh: 成本確認後，價格會據此訂定。

confusable.diff: according to 是介系詞片語，意思是「根據…」，後面接名詞；accordingly 是副詞。
confusable.usage: according to 後面接資料來源或人（according to the report）；accordingly 單獨使用，放在句尾或動詞後。

example.en: According to the report, sales rose by five percent last month.
example.zh: 根據報告，上個月銷售成長了百分之五。

similar.diff: therefore 強調因果，是「因此」；accordingly 強調「依照前面的情況做相應處理」。

example.en: The budget is limited, and therefore we cannot hire anyone.
example.zh: 預算有限，因此我們無法聘人。

similar.diff: consequently 強調「結果」，語氣較正式；accordingly 強調「配合」。

example.en: Orders doubled, and consequently the warehouse needed more staff.
example.zh: 訂單增加一倍，因此倉庫需要更多人手。

example.en: The deadline has passed, so we therefore cannot accept new requests.
example.zh: 截止期限已過，因此我們無法接受新的申請。

example.en: Sales dropped, and consequently the team was reduced.
example.zh: 銷售下滑，因此團隊縮編。

example.en: Please dress appropriately for the client meeting.
example.zh: 請為客戶會議穿著得宜。

derived.link: accord 是詞幹，「一致」；according 是它的 -ing 形，accordingly 再加 -ly 變副詞
accord + -ance，變成名詞，像 appear → appearance；常見片語 in accordance with（依照）

extra_vocab.en: the act of pressing and rubbing the body to help it relax
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，massage sessions 是員工可用年度健康補助金支付的項目之一，和健身房會員、語言課程並列，屬於福利項目。

example.en: The spa hired a new massage therapist last month.
example.zh: 這間水療館上個月聘請了一位新的按摩治療師。

example.en: The hotel offers a free foot massage to all guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店提供所有賓客免費的足部按摩。

example.en: Each massage session lasts about forty-five minutes.
example.zh: 每次按摩療程大約持續四十五分鐘。

examples.en: The wellness credit can be used for a massage or a gym pass.
examples.zh: 健康補助金可用於按摩或健身房通行證。

examples.en: After the long flight, I booked a massage at the hotel.
examples.zh: 長途飛行後，我在飯店預約了按摩。

confusable.diff: message 是「訊息」，拼法只差一個字母，發音也不同，但常被看錯。

example.en: Please leave a message if the manager is not available.
example.zh: 如果經理不在，請留言。

similar.diff: spa treatment 是更廣的「水療護理」，可包含按摩、護膚；massage 專指按摩。

example.en: The package includes a spa treatment and a three-course dinner.
example.zh: 這個套裝行程包含一次水療護理和三道菜晚餐。

example.en: The company runs a wellness program for all employees.
example.zh: 公司為所有員工辦理身心健康計畫。

example.en: Physical therapy helped him recover from the injury.
example.zh: 物理治療幫助他從傷勢中復原。

example.en: The lounge offers a quiet space for relaxation.
example.zh: 休息室提供一個安靜的放鬆空間。

example.en: Regular exercise can help reduce work stress.
example.zh: 規律運動有助於減輕工作壓力。

example.en: A short massage can help you relax after a long day.
example.zh: 忙了一整天後，短時間的按摩能幫助放鬆。

example.en: The therapist will massage your shoulders for twenty minutes.
example.zh: 治療師會為你按摩肩膀二十分鐘。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，it is unnecessary to bring any documents 是告訴員工：新線上表單取代紙本，所以不必親自帶文件到人資部，語氣是方便、省事的提醒。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型 it is unnecessary (for + 人) to + V，to 後面接原形動詞。

example.en: We should avoid unnecessary costs during the busy season.
example.zh: 旺季期間，我們應該避免不必要的成本。

example.en: Please submit the form today to prevent unnecessary delay.
example.zh: 請今天就送出表格，以免不必要的延誤。

example.en: It is unnecessary to call us if the system is working.
example.zh: 如果系統運作正常，就不必打電話給我們。

example.en: Try to avoid unnecessary meetings so that the team can focus.
example.zh: 請盡量避免不必要的會議，讓團隊能專心。

examples.en: It is unnecessary to print the form; you can submit it online.
examples.zh: 不必列印表格，您可以在線上提交。

examples.en: The extra step proved unnecessary and slowed down the whole process.
examples.zh: 多出來的這個步驟被證明沒必要，還拖慢了整個流程。

similar.diff: needless 較書面，常修飾 expense、delay 等名詞；unnecessary 更常用，也能用在 It is unnecessary to ... 句型。

example.en: The new system will reduce needless paperwork in the office.
example.zh: 新系統將減少辦公室裡不必要的文書作業。

similar.diff: not required 是較白話的「不需要」，強調規定上不要求；unnecessary 強調「沒有必要」。

example.en: A signature is not required for deliveries under fifty dollars.
example.zh: 五十美元以下的包裹不需要簽收。

example.en: Attendance at the safety training is required for all staff.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須參加安全訓練。

example.en: The extra workshop is optional but strongly recommended.
example.zh: 額外的工作坊是自由參加，但強烈建議出席。

example.en: Clear communication is essential for any successful project.
example.zh: 清楚的溝通對任何成功的專案都不可或缺。

example.en: There is no extra charge for online payments.
example.zh: 線上付款不收額外費用。

derived.link: necessary 是詞幹；加上 un-（不）就變成 unnecessary，像 happy → unhappy
necessary 去 -ary 加 -ity，變成名詞，像 able → ability
